## About
S & S Machine Shop is an automotive machine shop on N Rogers in Mesa, serving Mesa and the East Valley. We rebuild cylinder heads, machine blocks, grind and polish crankshafts, and handle engine repair and rebuilds.
Our machinists clean and inspect every job so the repair is done properly. They have many years of experience and they love working on engines, from European to Japanese and the odd ball project too.
A lot of our first-time customers keep coming back for their engine work. If you have a question about your engine, bring it in for an inspection and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Engine repair and rebuilds: Full engine repair and rebuilding, handled with care from teardown to inspection.
- Cylinder head rebuilding: Cylinder head rebuilds, including valve jobs and pressure tests.
- Milling heads and blocks: Milling and resurfacing of cylinder heads and blocks.
- Bore and hone cylinder blocks: Boring and honing to get your block ready for the build.
- Crank shaft grinding and polishing: Grinding and polishing of crank shafts.
- Connecting rod reconditioning: Reconditioning connecting rods for your rebuild.
- Balancing: Balancing your bottom end as part of your engine build.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Mondays through Thursdays during the day. We're closed Friday, Saturday and Sunday, so plan your drop-off early in the week.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We provide automotive machine shop services to Mesa and the East Valley. You'll find us on N Rogers in Mesa.

Q: If I send a message, when will I hear back?
A: If a reply is needed, you'll hear back within 48-72 hours. For anything sooner, give the shop a call.
